title: Parse Server buildUpdatedObject Prototype Pollution Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Parse Server. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the buildUpdatedObject function. The issue results from the lack of control over modifications to attributes of object prototypes. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
